requirement: Implement only the operator-approved free one-shot vNext manifest allocation development primitive. Policy commit 4f215bfcc3b9d3b0098303d333d1dd7fea19f30e and file SHA-256 dacdaab3360b7d848ea622bf83cc6a49c519c8a2f50ed1bc2d8b34a9a5b5ef7b were approved by mposition for no-cost owner-runner/server binding code, synthetic tests and Claude independent review. This module combines the prior root rehash with existing HMAC allocation, language/cell/challenge/direction quotas and bounded source text checks inside a future owner-only environment. It is deliberately not a complete witness/predicate/rubric validator, seal authority or dispatch admission. No real holdout content is authored, requested or inspected. Codex authors; Claude Code Max first-party subscription CLI reviews read-only, with user-approved skip-preflight exception and no Anthropic API. No provider call, cost reservation, stage/run approval, flag, product activation, PR merge or deployment is authorized.
completionCriteria: Read the exact requirement and scoped diff before tests or author account; bind the verdict to the package digest.
Confirm full-manifest root/preregistration binding is checked before extracting any metadata and raw content/root never leaves the owner-only function return value.

Confirm the existing strict allocation validator checks the 32-byte seed HMAC permutation, 80 unique ko/en IDs, exact cells/challenges and closed direction/reason contract; each sourceText uses the existing vNext bounds.

Confirm the primitive machine-readably reports fullManifestValidated false and dispatchAuthorized false because witness, predicate, rubric truth, durable approvals and deployment/cost checks remain absent. Do not treat it as sealing or operational gate evidence.
Confirm all inputs in tests are labelled synthetic and new source/tests are byte-pinned in a separate development-only closure, including its own closure test.
Require focused tests, typecheck, lint, policy-reference and whitespace guards. Distinguish controller-recorded checks from commands the read-only reviewer actually ran.
Return exactly one raw JSON verdict without Markdown fences and with only reproducible actionable findings. Approval with findings is not a controller pass.
